extracted.intended_audience: young writers and aspiring fiction authors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for composing serious/ literary fiction that maintains reader immersion and moral seriousness; covers both aesthetic principles and technical craft. Useful for novelists and short-story writers seeking to avoid common faults and strengthen narrative cohesion.

rubrics_metrics.name: The Vivid and Continuous Dream
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiction is 'a vivid and continuous dream' for readers; the writer's primary obligation is to avoid disrupting this dream with any false note.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All writing choices should serve to sustain immersion; any element that pulls the reader out (inconsistency, awkward prose, unearned explanation) violates this central principle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment
rubrics_metrics.description: Total artistic commitment to the work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The writer must fully engage with the material and take the subject seriously; half-hearted treatment undermines the work's power.

rubrics_metrics.name: Truth / Believability
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiction must be believable — not 'perceived by the reader as a lie' — and should 'affirm moral truths about human existence.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Truth here is aesthetic and moral: characters' motives and events must feel earned and authentic to maintain the dream and convey moral insight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Precise Sensory Detail
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific, tangible details ground scenes and characters; vagueness or abstract generalities weaken immersion and make prose feel untrue.

rubrics_metrics.name: Profluence (Narrative Forward Motion)
rubrics_metrics.description: The principle of what moves narrative forward and holds it together.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Every element should contribute to forward motion — antecedent-consequence logic, causality, and storytelling economy that prevent digression and keep the 'dream' continuous.

rubrics_metrics.name: Key Components: Subject, Plot, Character, Setting, Theme, Style
rubrics_metrics.description: Fiction comprises subject, plot, character, setting, theme, and style as its components.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assess and develop each element: subject choice, coherent plotting, believable characters, evocative setting, coherent theme, and a style that serves the story and sustains the dream.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moral Function of Fiction
rubrics_metrics.description: Serious fiction has a moral function — to model human nuance, develop empathy, and engage truth at a deep level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Beyond entertainment, fiction should explore moral complexity; avoid shallow moralizing or manipulative emotionalism that does not arise organically from the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-Part Approach: Aesthetics + Technical Craft
rubrics_metrics.description: Understand fiction in two parts: (1) what fiction is — aesthetics, the dream, moral function; (2) technical matters — sentence structure, mechanics, craft.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both the philosophical/aesthetic aims and the technical execution must be attended to; failing in either breaks the dream.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid Clumsy Prose
rubrics_metrics.description: Clumsy prose — awkward sentences that pull the reader out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Write sentences that fit the thought and tone; revise for clarity and ease of reading so sentence-level awkwardness does not interrupt immersion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid Needless Explanation (Telling vs. Showing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Needless explanation — telling instead of showing; excess exposition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prefer showing through action, detail, and scene rather than authorial summary; only explain when it genuinely serves the reader's understanding and the dream.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid Sentimentality
rubrics_metrics.description: Sentimentality — unearned emotion; manipulating reader feeling.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emotion must be earned by the work's events and character development; avoid cheap devices that try to force tears or sympathy without groundwork.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid Mannerism
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Distinctive style should arise naturally from the work's needs rather than display tricks or repetitive idiosyncrasies that call attention to the author.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid Frigidity
rubrics_metrics.description: Frigidity — coldness; failure to take subject seriously.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not treat subjects superficially or with ironic distance that prevents genuine engagement; emotional or moral coldness can deaden the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid Faulty Rhythm
rubrics_metrics.description: Faulty rhythm — sentence rhythm that doesn't match content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Match sentence length, cadence, and rhythm to the scene's energy and emotional tone; mismatched rhythm draws attention and disrupts immersion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use Appropriate Diction
rubrics_metrics.description: Inappropriate diction — wrong word choices for context.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose words that fit character, setting, and tone; voice and diction should feel authentic to the narrative world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Respect Point of View
rubrics_metrics.description: Misuse of point of view — inconsistent or violated POV.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain a coherent POV; avoid intrusions or shifts that contradict the chosen narrative stance and break reader trust.

rubrics_metrics.name: Motivate Character Actions
rubrics_metrics.description: Unmotivated character action — behavior not earned.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Characters' decisions and actions must follow from established traits, desires, and circumstances; avoid plot conveniences that feel arbitrary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid Overuse of Metaphor / Fancy Language
rubrics_metrics.description: Overuse of metaphor / fancy language — showy prose that distracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use figurative language to illuminate, not to dazzle; excessive ornamentation can pull readers out of the dream and mask weak substance.
